div.head: II Atr 8
div.ab: Si quis deprehendat quod amisit, aduocet inde cum quo deprehenditur, unde uenerit ei; et mittat in manum et det plegium, quod adducet aduocatum suum.
Gyf hwa befo þæt him losod wæs, cenne se, ðe he hit æt befo, hwanon hit him come; sylle on hand ⁊ sette borh, þæt he bringe his geteaman in, ðær hit besprecen bið.

[Be ðon ðe mon gefô ðe him losod wæs.] [Ld] Gyf hwa befo þæt him losod wæs, cenne se ðe he hit æt befo, hwanon hit him come; sylle on hand ⁊ sette borh, þæt he bringe his geteaman in ðær hit besprecen bið.

If anyone attaches what he has lost, the man in whose possession it is attached shall declare how it came to him. He shall give pledges and furnish surety that he will produce his warrantor, when the case shall be brought into court.

App. zu II Atr. 8. (Davon, dass jemand im Anefang fasst, was ihm verloren ging. Ld) Wenn jemand was ihm verloren ging, im Anefang fasst, so erkläre der [Besitzer], bei dem er es fasst, woher es an ihn [den Besitzer] gekommen sei, gelobe (in die Hand) und setze Bürgschaft, dass er seinen Gewährsmann dort, wo es eingeklagt worden ist, hinbringen werde.

Appendix to II Atr. 8. (Of attaching what one has lost. Ld) If anyone attaches what he had lost, let the [possessor] at whose house he attaches it declare where it came to him from, give a pledge (into the hand) and provide surety that he will bring his warrantor to the place where it is claimed.
